CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, February 16, 2022

1.  Chairperson Simison called the regular meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:31 p.m. via teleconference.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Simison led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Thomas Allison, Jason Lorge,
  Jeremy Conrad, and Jason Simison. Planning Commissioners not present: Jeffry
  Allred. Advisory personnel present: Community Development Director Eric
  Scherer, City Attorney Bob Kress, Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera, Principal
  Planner Candice Bowcock and Secretary Natalie Hiatt.

4.  DECLARATION OF EMERGENCY

  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54953, the Planning Commission may
  continue to hold their public meetings via teleconference due to COVID-19
  pandemic by adopting a resolution. Staff recommends the adoption of Resolution
  No. 1284 declaring the need to continue to meet teleconferencing at this time.

  It was moved by Commissioner Conrad and seconded by Commissioner Lorge to
  approve the adoption of Resolution 1284. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

5.  MINUTES – November 10, 2021

  It was moved by Commissioner Allison and seconded by Commissioner Conrad
  to approve the minutes of the November 10, 2021 meeting. Motion carried by a 4-
  0 vote.

6.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

OTHER MATTERS

  Mr. Scherer stated that the following projects are not noticed public hearings
  and should be listed as “Other Matters”.
 Planning Commission Minutes
February 16, 2022
7.  CASE NO. 96-20CUP; A ONE YEAR EXTENSION REQUEST FOR A
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO EXPAND THE FOUNTAINS MOBILE
  HOME PARK’S EXISTING RECREATIONAL VEHICLE PARKING LOT
  LOCATED AT 3530 DAMIEN AVENUE.

  RESOLUTION NO. 1267

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  APPROVING CASE NO. 96-20CUP, A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO
  ALLOW FOR THE EXPANSION OF THE CURRENT RV STORAGE
  LOT AT 3530 DAMIEN AVENUE, AND AFFIRMING THAT THE
  PROJECT IS EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL
  QUALITY ACT.

  Mr. Rivera presented his staff report.

  Mr. Scherer stated that the applicant was not present.

  It was moved by Commissioner Lorge and seconded by Commissioner Allison to
  approve the extension request for 96-20CUP. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

8.  CASE NO. 72-15IUP & 73-15PPR; FINAL EXTENSION REQUEST FOR
  AN INTERIM USE PERMIT FOR AMERICAN CLASSIC CARS
  LOCATED AT 2282 ARROW HIGHWAY.

  RESOLUTION NO. 1150

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  APPROVING CASE NO. 72-15IUP, AN INTERIM USE PERMIT TO
  ALLOW A CLASSIC CAR DEALERSHIP BUSINESS AT 2282 ARROW
  HIGHWAY, AND AFFIRMING THAT THE PROJECT IS EXEMPT
  FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL ACT.

  Ms. Bowcock presented her staff report. The applicant was not present.

  It was moved by Commissoner Lorge and seconded by Commissioner Conrad to
  approve the extension request for Case No. 72-15IUP. Motion carried by a 4-0
  vote.

PUBLIC HEARING

9.  CASE NO. 07-22GPA; HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE

  2
 Planning Commission Minutes
February 16, 2022
  Ms. Bowcock stated that the Draft 2021-2029 Housing Element Update was
  submitted in December 2021, to the California Department of Housing and
  Community Development. A comment letter was received from HCD on
  February 1, 2022 requesting that some areas of the draft be enhanced. Staff is
  recommending that the Planning Commission continue the noticed public hearing
  to the regularly scheduled meeting on March 9, 2022.

  It was moved by Commission Conrad and seconded by Commissioner Allison to
  continue the public hearing to the regularly scheduled meeting on March 9, 2022.
  Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:52 p.m. The next regular meeting of the Planning
  Commission will be held March 9, 2022 at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers,
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.
